Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran it by the InfoSec and Clinical teams; they're interested in a Private VPC proof-of-concept but have three gating items before procurement will consider a credit-backed trial:

1) Short SOC2 summary and attestations showing encryption at rest + HSM key support.
2) On-call/process commitment for escalations during the 60-day trial window.
3) An MOU or support addendum stating: (a) trial credits, (b) data residency in us-east-1, (c) audit log retention policy.

Would Redwood consider issuing 30k trial credits for a 60-day Private VPC eval contingent on signing a short MOU and our ability to review the SOC2 summary? If so, please include the required evidence list and a point of contact for on-call scheduling.

Attached: MedSure high-level security checklist (for your reference).

Best,

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the clear ask. A few technical confirmations and proposals: 

* HSM / key management: We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM in Private deployments. For the POC we can do either (A) generate a temporary customer key in your KMS and store only wrapped keys in the VPC, or (B) provide a short-lived Redwood-managed HSM key with attestations. Option A is preferred for audit purposes.
* SOC2: attaching a one-page redwood SOC2 summary PDF (redacted). Full report is under NDA; we can coordinate an in-person or secure artifact review if needed.
* On-call: we'll provide a dedicated POC escalation channel (pager + Slack huddle) during business hours plus a shared on-call rotation for critical incidents — target response SLO: 1 hour for P1 during trial. We will document the on-call rota in the MOU appendix.
* Ops checklist: I'll attach our Private VPC Ops checklist (runbook) that covers networking, peering, and allowed egress.

Questions for MedSure: expected QPS, peak concurrent tokens per minute, and whether you'll need IP allowlist or SAML integration for the admin console. That will influence capacity planning and any dedicated instance sizing.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
